# BNI Anchor Hong Kong

> BNI Anchor is a Thursday BNI business-networking chapter in Hong Kong, founded on 6 November 2025. Members practise Givers Gain through introductions and referrals for long-term business.

BNI Anchor (BNI Anchor 香港分會) serves professionals and business owners across Hong Kong.

## Facts

- Chapter: BNI Anchor
- Region: Hong Kong
- Founded: 6 November 2025
- Meeting day: Thursday
- Meeting time and venue: announced on Facebook and Instagram
- Visitor enquiry WhatsApp: +852 6698 9778
- Languages: Traditional Chinese, English
- Official site: https://www.bni-anchor.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bni.anchor.hk/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61583828314420
- Member directory: https://burkaslarry.github.io/bni-anchor/

## Pages

- [Member directory](https://burkaslarry.github.io/bni-anchor/#members): searchable bilingual list of chapter members, professions, companies and Instagram
- [Our clients](https://burkaslarry.github.io/bni-anchor/#clients): companies served by members
- [Business meeting](https://burkaslarry.github.io/bni-anchor/#location): chapter intro and social links for time and venue
- [Enquire](https://burkaslarry.github.io/bni-anchor/#inquire): visitor form that opens WhatsApp to book a business meeting

## How to visit

Guests can submit first name, last name, phone, email and industry on the enquire form. The site opens WhatsApp to +852 6698 9778 with those details so the chapter treasurer can arrange a visitor meeting. Check Facebook and Instagram for the current meeting time and address.
